separately_gated_future_phases.name: IDENTITY_AND_DEPENDENCY_PREFLIGHT
checks: Resolve exact tokenizer files and compute their identities before use.
Require exact match to the approved tokenizer identity or stop fail-closed.
Record library, tokenizer implementation, platform, and decoding configuration identities.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: TOKENIZER_INVENTORY
checks: Enumerate vocabulary size, added tokens, BOS, EOS, PAD, UNK, and every special/control token.
Record normalization, pre-tokenization, byte-fallback, cleanup, and decoder behavior.
Classify empty, control-bearing, replacement-character, and otherwise non-text token decodings.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: STANDALONE_DECODE_MAP
checks: Decode each vocabulary token without generation or model invocation.
Record byte and Unicode behavior without treating standalone decoding as compositional proof.
Identify collisions where distinct token IDs have the same standalone decoding.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: CONTEXTUAL_COMPOSITIONALITY_MATRIX
checks: Compare decode(prefix plus candidate) with decode(prefix) across valid prefixes in every character-controller mode.
Cover literals, enums, punctuation, SHA-256 references, decimal offsets, JSON strings, escapes, Unicode, closing transitions, and terminal states.
Classify whether the candidate contributes a stable suffix, rewrites prior decoded text, or depends on decoder context.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: BYTE_FALLBACK_AND_INCOMPLETE_SEQUENCE_AUDIT
checks: Exercise incomplete and completed multibyte sequences across token boundaries.
Detect replacement-character or cleanup behavior that can make incremental decoded text unstable.
Require prefix-sensitive full decode for every unstable class.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: FULL_VOCABULARY_ONE_STEP_ADMISSION
checks: At representative request-bound states, compare every token's complete decoded effect with a fresh full character-controller rebuild.
Verify token-level liveness separately from character-level liveness.
Verify EOS only at terminal and exclusion of every other special token.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: STRATEGY_EQUIVALENCE_DECISION
checks: Compare the complete allowed-token sets from the context-free trie candidate and prefix-sensitive full-decode oracle.
Permit context-free projection only for classes with exact equality and no unstable decoding.
Otherwise select the prefix-sensitive design; mixed strategies require explicit class boundaries and receipts.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: ZERO_INFERENCE_RESOURCE_CHARACTERIZATION
checks: Measure deterministic latency, memory, cache hit isolation, and rebuild cost without model loading or inference.
Confirm cache identities prevent cross-request and cross-decoder reuse.
Produce a recommendation only; do not implement or bind a production projector.

stop_conditions: Tokenizer identity mismatch or unresolved dependency identity.
Any context-sensitive decoding not safely handled by the evaluated strategy.
Any false acceptance, EOS leak, special-token leak, or cache isolation failure.
Any step requiring model inference, evaluator/runner binding, or probe construction.
recommended_separately_authorized_next_s: Load only the identity-bound tokenizer and execute Phases 0-7 as a zero-inference compatibility audit; stop with evidence and a strategy recommendation before projector implementation.
